laws.name: Food Sharing
laws.description: When food runs short, every household gets the same share. In a short shortage nobody starves while others eat; in a famine everyone goes hungry together. Shared pots waste a little: everyone eats 8% more.

laws.name: Elders Settle Disputes
laws.description: Quarrels go before the elders instead of festering: unrest 40% lower. The elders' time goes into hearings: their knowledge -20%.

laws.name: Shared Labour
laws.description: Every household owes days of work on the common buildings: building 35% faster. People resent the call-ups: happiness -6%.

laws.name: Rationing
laws.description: Portions are measured out: everyone eats 15% less. Thin meals wear people down: happiness -10% and sickness 25% more likely.
